categories.name: Relationships
categories.description: On the people who stay, the people who drift, and what they leave behind.

categories.name: Growing Up
categories.description: On childhood, adulthood and the distance between them.

categories.name: Inner Life
categories.description: On the feelings we carry quietly and rarely say out loud.

categories.name: Resilience
categories.description: On patience, permission and making room for yourself.

publications.title: The Person I Once Needed
publications.description: There comes a quiet moment when you realise nobody is coming to fix things for you. An essay on growing up, standing on your own, and slowly becoming the support you once looked for in others.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: If All the Seats Are Taken, Take the Stage
publications.description: We spend years waiting to be noticed, invited and given a chance. An essay on dropping the habit of waiting for permission and creating your own place instead.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: Strangers Who Know All Your Stories
publications.description: Some friendships don't end with a fight; they fade into birthday wishes and festival messages. An essay on the people who once knew everything about your day.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: Surrounded by Everyone, Understood by No One
publications.description: You can sit in a room full of people and still feel unseen. An essay on the different versions of ourselves we show the world, and the wish to be understood without explaining.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: The Childhood We Were in a Hurry to Leave
publications.description: As children we couldn't wait to grow up; as adults we wish we could go back. An essay on cricket in the lane, lazy Sundays, and the days we didn't know we'd miss.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: The First Flower a Man Receives
publications.description: Be strong, don't cry, handle it. An essay on the feelings men are taught to keep to themselves, and why appreciation shouldn't wait until it's too late.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: Sometimes, All You Need Is Patience
publications.description: We want answers, results and happiness right away. An essay on staying steady while life takes its time, and trusting what grows beneath the surface.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: The People We Remember, and the People They Become
publications.description: Not everyone we lose is gone; sometimes life simply changes them, and us. An essay on old friends, familiar faces and the versions of people we hold on to.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote

publications.title: Not Everyone Is Meant to Stay
publications.description: Love isn't always measured by how long someone stays. An essay on goodbyes that never get said, and on being grateful for the people who were part of your story.
publications.author: Dheeraj Rote
